subject: Weekly exec staff — Sprint readiness, QBR inputs, and escape hatches
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: exec-staff@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec staff — Sprint readiness, QBR inputs, and escape hatches

Team —

Quick weekly pulse ahead of QBR prep: I pulled together the high-level wins, the top risks we should be honest about, and the asks where exec help will move the needle. Attached is a one-pager (QBR_playbook_v2.pdf) and the latency heatmap for the sprint (latency-heatmap-q3.png). Please review and flag anything missing by EOD Monday so I can fold into the consolidated deck.

Wins
- Hosted API: 12% lower p95 for 2-token cold-starts after kernel patch; confidence: runbook validated in staging.
- Redwood Dedicated: onboarding checklist completed for two pilot customers (Field Solutions, Acme Corp) — pilot scheduling next week.
- Optimize: Automated suggestion engine returned model/quantization recommendations for 3 high-TCO customers, first batch will reduce token cost ~18% on sample workloads.

Top risks
- Capacity: We have an ephemeral shortage on A100 pools in us-west for Sept 22–25; risk of throttled demos. Need a fallback plan (dedicated warm-borrow, spend to burst).
- Quality regression: One recommendation path in Optimize increased hallucination rate in long-form summaries; requires additional evals before recommending broadly.
- Legal/Procurement: Field Solutions requires a redline (Section 7) and faster SOC2 evidence; procurement says standard SLA exception may be needed.

Asks (specific and timeboxed)
1) Laura — approve $40k burst credit for 3 days if we can’t secure A100s by Wednesday STMT (decision by Tue 12pm PT).
2) Karthik — expedite legal review on Field Solutions redline; can we commit to a tight turnaround (48 hrs)?
3) Marissa — coordinate a dry-run demo with Acme on Sept 24 using fallback model variant; confirm operator and test script by Sept 21.

Notes and attachments
- QBR one-pager is focused on economy and reliability signals; I annotated the suggested talking points in the Notion link.
- HubSpot: I linked the Acme pilot record (hs-record-14278) for context.

Thanks — short and actionable this week, please ping if anything needs a different framing.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec staff — Sprint readiness, QBR inputs, and escape hatches

Marcus —

Thanks for the crisp breakdown. Quick replies inline:

- Approve the $40k burst credit if procurement confirms spend window is locked to Sept 22–25 (please confirm exact calendar days).
- Karthik — please prioritize Field Solutions redline; if legal needs the contract team looped, escalate to me.
- Marissa — good call on the dry-run; include a telemetry checklist so we can validate fallback behavior in <60s.

One additional ask: can someone produce a 90s executive script that summarizes the capacity mitigation plan (two bullet mitigation + fallback) — I’d like it in the QBR appendix.

Laura
